title: OpenDSS
description: Documented public distribution simulation (EPRI (open source)) for the Energy Grid Orchestrator capability area.
body:
OpenDSS is a documented distribution simulation from EPRI (open source). EPRI's open-source distribution system simulator: the standard for modeling feeders with distributed solar and storage.

How it works: It works by stepping hour by hour, charging storage on surplus and discharging on deficit, and reporting any unmet demand.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
